The summary only counts values the agreement fixes, and it fixes no category value. 2. C5: whether the worker read only approved accounts can only be checked with scope of a call on named read lines. That cannot go in a plan, so it must be paid from the allowance of 50 at A1, which covers at most 5 lines out of about 101 reads. I will pick lines by what the record shows (rows returned, items, odd fp_in). 3. C10: sent as released reads the record, not the outbox. A confirmed reply does not show that a row was appended, and a preview appends none under the same label. Only trace of a call on named lines at A3 can show it, again at most 5 lines from the allowance; I will put any line that is ordered and not confirmed first. 4. Live tables: same set and the summary read the staged set by its fingerprint and never the live tables. That the live tables carry exactly that set rests on the promotion's line in the record (fp_in/fp_out), not on an answer. An instrument that reads the live tables after the promotion was missing. 5. Repeating same set or the summary at A2 or A3 would only restate what they said at A1, so I left them out.
